## 1) Install and Load Packages

```{r packages}
required_pkgs <- c("highfrequency", "data.table")

for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
}

library(highfrequency)
library(data.table)
```

## 2) Load Processed Data from okx-highfrequency

```{r load-data}
input_paths <- c(
  "target/eth_2601_1m.csv",
  "target/eth_2602_1m.csv"
)

missing_paths <- input_paths[!file.exists(input_paths)]
if (length(missing_paths) > 0) {
  stop("Missing input file(s): ", paste(missing_paths, collapse = ", "))
}

hf_list <- lapply(input_paths, fread)
hf <- rbindlist(hf_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE, idcol = "source_id")

required_cols <- c("DT", "PRICE")

if (!all(required_cols %in% names(hf))) {
  stop("Input CSV must contain columns: DT and PRICE.")
}

# Prefer MIDQUOTE if present, otherwise fallback to PRICE.
price_col <- if ("MIDQUOTE" %in% names(hf)) "MIDQUOTE" else "PRICE"

hf <- hf[!is.na(DT) & !is.na(get(price_col))]
hf[, DT := as.POSIXct(DT, tz = "UTC")]
hf <- hf[!is.na(DT)]
setorder(hf, DT)

pData <- hf[, .(DT, PRICE = as.numeric(get(price_col)))]
pData <- pData[is.finite(PRICE) & PRICE > 0]

cat("Using file:", data_path, "\n")
cat("Rows after cleanup:", nrow(pData), "\n")
cat("Price source column:", price_col, "\n")
head(pData)
```

```{r return-autocorrelation-by-frequency}
# Sampling frequencies (in minutes) to compare.
acf_sample_periods <- c(1L, 2L, 5L, 10L, 15L, 30L, 60L)
acf_lag_max <- 5L

compute_return_acf_summary <- function(pdata, periods, lag_max = 5L, tz = "UTC") {
  out_list <- lapply(periods, function(period_mins) {
    sampled <- data.table::copy(pdata)
    if (period_mins > 1L) {
      sampled <- aggregatePrice(
        sampled,
        alignBy = "minutes",
        alignPeriod = period_mins,
        marketOpen = "00:00:00",
        marketClose = "23:59:59",
        tz = tz
      )
    }

    sampled <- as.data.table(sampled)
    setorder(sampled, DT)

    sampled[, return := log(PRICE) - data.table::shift(log(PRICE), type = "lag")]
    ret <- sampled[is.finite(return), return]

    if (length(ret) < (lag_max + 1L)) {
      return(data.table(
        sample_minutes = period_mins,
        n_returns = length(ret),
        lag1_to_lag5_acf_sum = NA_real_,
        lag1_acf = NA_real_,
        lag2_acf = NA_real_,
        lag3_acf = NA_real_,
        lag4_acf = NA_real_,
        lag5_acf = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    acf_obj <- stats::acf(ret, plot = FALSE, lag.max = lag_max, na.action = na.pass)
    # acf() includes lag 0 at index 1; lags 1..lag_max are indices 2..(lag_max+1)
    lag_vals <- as.numeric(acf_obj$acf[2:(lag_max + 1L)])

    data.table(
      sample_minutes = period_mins,
      n_returns = length(ret),
      lag1_to_lag5_acf_sum = sum(lag_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      lag1_to_lag5_acf_abs_sum = sum(abs(lag_vals), na.rm = TRUE),
      lag1_acf = lag_vals[1],
      lag2_acf = lag_vals[2],
      lag3_acf = lag_vals[3],
      lag4_acf = lag_vals[4],
      lag5_acf = lag_vals[5]
    )
  })

  rbindlist(out_list, fill = TRUE)
}

return_acf_summary <- compute_return_acf_summary(
  pData,
  periods = acf_sample_periods,
  lag_max = acf_lag_max,
  tz = "UTC"
)

cat("Autocorrelation summary (sum of lag 1..5):\n")
return_acf_summary
```

```{r return-autocorrelation-plot}
barplot(
  height = return_acf_summary$lag1_to_lag5_acf_sum,
  names.arg = return_acf_summary$sample_minutes,
  xlab = "Sampling Frequency (minutes)",
  ylab = "Sum of ACF (lags 1 to 5)",
  main = "Return Serial Correlation by Sampling Frequency",
  col = "steelblue"
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "gray40")
```

## 3) Daily Jump Test (BNS)

`BNSjumpTest` tests for jumps at the daily level when multi-day intraday prices are provided.

```{r daily-bns-test}
# Controls sampling frequency used for the daily jump test.
# If your raw data are 1-minute bars and you want 15-minute testing, set this to 15.
# Set to 1 to use the original 1-minute sampling.
daily_jump_align_by <- "minutes"
daily_jump_align_period <- 2L

# Two-sided daily significance level (5% => alpha quantile 0.975 in BNSjumpTest)
daily_jump_sig_level <- 0.05
daily_jump_alpha_quantile <- 1 - daily_jump_sig_level / 2

# Aggregate prices for daily jump test frequency control.
pData_daily_test <- data.table::copy(pData)
if (!is.null(daily_jump_align_period) && daily_jump_align_period > 1) {
  pData_daily_test <- aggregatePrice(
    pData_daily_test,
    alignBy = daily_jump_align_by,
    alignPeriod = daily_jump_align_period,
    marketOpen = "00:00:00",
    marketClose = "23:59:59",
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}

# Guard against days with <=1 sampled observation (can break makeReturns inside BNSjumpTest).
pData_daily_test <- as.data.table(pData_daily_test)
pData_daily_test[, DATE := as.Date(DT, tz = "UTC")]
valid_dates <- pData_daily_test[, .N, by = DATE][N > 1, DATE]
pData_daily_test <- pData_daily_test[DATE %in% valid_dates, .(DT, PRICE)]

daily_bns <- BNSjumpTest(
  rData = pData_daily_test,
  type = "ratio",
  max = TRUE,
  makeReturns = TRUE,
  alpha = daily_jump_alpha_quantile
)

extract_daily_bns_summary <- function(obj, sig_level = 0.05, tz = "UTC") {
  # Case 1: multi-day output returned as list of per-day lists
  if (is.list(obj) && !xts::is.xts(obj) && length(obj) > 0 && is.list(obj[[1]])) {
    out <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(obj), function(i) {
      x <- obj[[i]]
      dname <- if (!is.null(names(obj))) names(obj)[i] else NA_character_
      date_val <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(dname))
      crit <- as.numeric(x$critical.value)
      data.table(
        DATE = date_val,
        ztest = as.numeric(x$ztest)[1],
        critical_lower = if (length(crit) >= 1) crit[1] else NA_real_,
        critical_upper = if (length(crit) >= 2) crit[2] else NA_real_,
        pvalue = as.numeric(x$pvalue)[1]
      )
    }), fill = TRUE)
  } else if (xts::is.xts(obj)) {
    # Case 2: multi-day output returned as xts
    out <- data.table(
      DATE = as.Date(zoo::index(obj), tz = tz),
      as.data.frame(zoo::coredata(obj), check.names = FALSE)
    )
    p_col <- grep("^p.?value$|p-value|pvalue", names(out), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
    z_col <- grep("^z.?test$|^ztest$", names(out), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
    lo_col <- grep("^lower$", names(out), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
    up_col <- grep("^upper$", names(out), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
    out <- out[, .(
      DATE,
      ztest = as.numeric(get(z_col)),
      critical_lower = as.numeric(get(lo_col)),
      critical_upper = as.numeric(get(up_col)),
      pvalue = as.numeric(get(p_col))
    )]
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported BNSjumpTest output class: ", paste(class(obj), collapse = ", "))
  }

  out[, reject_null := !is.na(pvalue) & (pvalue < sig_level)]
  setorder(out, DATE)
  out
}

daily_bns_summary <- extract_daily_bns_summary(
  daily_bns,
  sig_level = daily_jump_sig_level,
  tz = "UTC"
)

daily_bns_reject <- daily_bns_summary[reject_null == TRUE]
```

```{r daily-bns-summary}
cat("Daily BNS test sampling:", daily_jump_align_period, daily_jump_align_by, "\n")
cat("Daily significance level:", daily_jump_sig_level, "\n")
cat("Days rejecting H0 (no-jump):", nrow(daily_bns_reject), "\n")
daily_bns_reject
```

```{r}
daily_bns_summary
```

## 4) Intraday Jump Test

```{r intraday-jump-test}
intraday_jumps <- intradayJumpTest(
  pData = pData,
  lookBackPeriod = 20,
  alignBy = "minutes",
  alignPeriod = 2,
  marketOpen = "00:00:00",
  marketClose = "23:59:59",
  tz = "UTC"
)

intraday_jumps
```

## 5) Summary and Visualization

```{r summarize-intraday-jumps}
if (!inherits(intraday_jumps, "intradayJumpTest")) {
  stop("Expected intraday_jumps to be class intradayJumpTest.")
}
if (!xts::is.xts(intraday_jumps$ztest)) {
  stop("Expected intraday_jumps$ztest to be xts.")
}

intraday_df <- data.table(
  DT = as.POSIXct(zoo::index(intraday_jumps$ztest), tz = "UTC"),
  ztest = as.numeric(intraday_jumps$ztest)
)
intraday_df[, criticalValue := as.numeric(intraday_jumps$criticalValue)[1]]
intraday_df[, jump_flag := !is.na(ztest) & is.finite(ztest) & (abs(ztest) > criticalValue)]
intraday_df[, DATE := as.Date(DT, tz = "UTC")]

# Keep only intraday jumps that happen on days where daily BNS rejects H0.
daily_reject_days <- unique(daily_bns_reject$DATE)
intraday_jump_events <- intraday_df[jump_flag == TRUE]

daily_intraday_jump_events <- merge(
  daily_bns_reject[, .(DATE, daily_ztest = ztest, daily_pvalue = pvalue)],
  intraday_jump_events[, .(DATE, DT, intraday_ztest = ztest)],
  by = "DATE",
  all.x = TRUE
)
setorder(daily_intraday_jump_events, DATE, DT)

daily_intraday_jump_summary <- daily_intraday_jump_events[, .(
  daily_ztest = first(daily_ztest),
  daily_pvalue = first(daily_pvalue),
  intraday_jump_count = sum(!is.na(DT)),
  intraday_jump_times = if (all(is.na(DT))) NA_character_ else paste(format(DT[!is.na(DT)], "%H:%M:%S"), collapse = ", ")
), by = DATE]

cat("Rows in daily-intraday event table:", nrow(daily_intraday_jump_events), "\n")
cat("Daily reject days with at least one intraday jump:", sum(daily_intraday_jump_summary$intraday_jump_count > 0), "\n")

daily_intraday_jump_summary
```

```{r intraday-plot-frequency-control}
# Plot sampling control for BOTH section-6 plots.
# Example: set to 15L to visualize at 15-minute resolution.
plot_align_by <- "minutes"
plot_align_period <- 2L

build_plot_prices <- function(pdata, align_by = "minutes", align_period = 1L, tz = "UTC") {
  out <- data.table::copy(pdata)
  if (!is.null(align_period) && align_period > 1) {
    out <- aggregatePrice(
      out,
      alignBy = align_by,
      alignPeriod = align_period,
      marketOpen = "00:00:00",
      marketClose = "23:59:59",
      tz = tz
    )
  }
  out <- as.data.table(out)
  setorder(out, DT)
  out
}

plot_price_data <- build_plot_prices(
  pData,
  align_by = plot_align_by,
  align_period = plot_align_period,
  tz = "UTC"
)

cat("Section-6 plotting resolution:", plot_align_period, plot_align_by, "\n")
```

```{r intraday-day-plot}
# Choose which day to visualize (YYYY-MM-DD). If NULL, we pick the first day in daily_bns_reject.
day_to_plot <- as.Date("2026-01-16")

if (is.null(day_to_plot)) {
  if (nrow(daily_bns_reject) == 0) {
    stop("No daily jump-reject days are available to plot.")
  }
  day_to_plot <- daily_bns_reject$DATE[1]
}

day_to_plot <- as.Date(day_to_plot)

plot_prices <- plot_price_data[as.Date(DT, tz = "UTC") == day_to_plot]
if (nrow(plot_prices) == 0) {
  stop("No price data found for selected day: ", as.character(day_to_plot))
}

plot_intraday <- intraday_df[DATE == day_to_plot]
plot_jump_points <- plot_intraday[jump_flag == TRUE, .(DT, ztest)]

plot(
  plot_prices$DT,
  plot_prices$PRICE,
  type = "l",
  col = "black",
  lwd = 1.2,
  xlab = "Time (UTC)",
  ylab = "Price",
  main = paste0(
    "Intraday Prices and Detected Jumps on ", day_to_plot,
    " (daily reject = ", day_to_plot %in% daily_reject_days, ")"
  )
)

if (nrow(plot_jump_points) > 0) {
  jump_plot_data <- plot_prices[plot_jump_points, on = "DT"]
  points(
    jump_plot_data$DT,
    jump_plot_data$PRICE,
    pch = 19,
    col = "red",
    cex = 0.9
  )
  text(
    jump_plot_data$DT,
    jump_plot_data$PRICE,
    labels = sprintf("z=%.2f", jump_plot_data$ztest),
    pos = 3,
    cex = 0.7,
    col = "red"
  )
}

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("Price", "Detected intraday jump"),
  col = c("black", "red"),
  lty = c(1, NA),
  pch = c(NA, 19),
  bty = "n"
)
```

```{r intraday-day-zoom-plot}
# Zoom control within the selected day_to_plot (HH:MM:SS, UTC)
zoom_start_time <- "8:00:00"
zoom_end_time <- "9:00:00"

zoom_start_dt <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(as.character(day_to_plot), zoom_start_time),
  tz = "UTC"
)
zoom_end_dt <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(as.character(day_to_plot), zoom_end_time),
  tz = "UTC"
)

plot_prices_zoom <- plot_price_data[DT >= zoom_start_dt & DT <= zoom_end_dt]
if (nrow(plot_prices_zoom) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No price data in selected zoom window: ",
    format(zoom_start_dt, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    " to ",
    format(zoom_end_dt, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    " (UTC)"
  )
}
plot_jump_points_zoom <- intraday_df[
  DATE == day_to_plot &
    DT >= zoom_start_dt &
    DT <= zoom_end_dt &
    jump_flag == TRUE,
  .(DT, ztest)
]
plot(
  plot_prices_zoom$DT,
  plot_prices_zoom$PRICE,
  type = "l",
  col = "black",
  lwd = 1.2,
  xlab = "Time (UTC)",
  ylab = "Price",
  main = paste0(
    "Zoomed Intraday Prices on ", day_to_plot, " (",
    zoom_start_time, " - ", zoom_end_time, " UTC)"
  )
)
if (nrow(plot_jump_points_zoom) > 0) {
  jump_plot_zoom <- plot_prices_zoom[plot_jump_points_zoom, on = "DT"]
  points(
    jump_plot_zoom$DT,
    jump_plot_zoom$PRICE,
    pch = 19,
    col = "red",
    cex = 0.9
  )
  text(
    jump_plot_zoom$DT,
    jump_plot_zoom$PRICE,
    labels = sprintf("z=%.2f", jump_plot_zoom$ztest),
    pos = 3,
    cex = 0.7,
    col = "red"
  )
}
legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("Price", "Detected intraday jump"),
  col = c("black", "red"),
  lty = c(1, NA),
  pch = c(NA, 19),
  bty = "n"
)
```
